task: Compare the breeds Afghan Hound, Akita and Azawakh.
agent_final_answer:
Comparison of Afghan Hound vs Akita vs Azawakh (from AKC Compare Breeds tool):

| Attribute        | Afghan Hound        | Akita                              | Azawakh                                  |
|------------------|---------------------|------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
| Personality      | independent, sweet  | dignified, courageous, profoundly loyal | independent, loyal, deeply affectionate |
| Popularity Rank  | 117th most popular  | 62nd most popular                  | 195th most popular                       |
| Group            | Hound Group         | Working Group                      | Hound Group                              |
| Size category    | Large               | XLarge                             | Large                                    |
| Height           | 25-27 in            | 26-28 in (M) / 24-26 in (F)        | 25-29 in (M) / 23.5-27.5 in (F)          |
| Weight           | 50-60 lb            | 100-130 lb (M) / 70-100 lb (F)     | 44-55 lb (M) / 33-44 lb (F)              |
| Life Expectancy  | 12-18 years         | 10-14 years                        | 12-15 years                              |
| Good w/ Children | Better w/ Supervision | Better w/ Supervision            | Better w/ Supervision                    |
| Good w/ Dogs     | With Supervision    | Not Recommended                    | With Supervision                         |
| Trainability     | May be Stubborn     | Agreeable                          | Independent                              |
| Coat Length      | Long                | Medium                             | Short                                    |
| Grooming         | Daily Brushing      | 2-3 Times a Week Brushing          | Weekly Brushing                          |
| Shedding         | Infrequent          | Seasonal                           | Occasional                               |
| Activity Level   | Energetic           | Energetic                          | Regular Exercise                         |
| Barking          | Medium              | When Necessary                     | Infrequent                               |

Summary: The Akita is the largest and heaviest (Working Group), least tolerant of other dogs, and most agreeable to train, with seasonal shedding and a medium coat. The Afghan Hound and Azawakh are both Hound Group sighthounds; the Afghan has a long coat needing daily brushing and is the longest-lived (up to 18 yrs), while the Azawakh is the leanest/lightest, rarest (195th), short-coated, and the quietest barker. All three need supervision around young children.
